answer: Cluster identities by behavioral similarity, then slash correlated ones together. Each agent stakes a bond; the network fingerprints timing, tool sequences and counterparties, grouping identities that graze the same meadow of habits. Past a correlation threshold the cluster's bonds freeze and lockstep groups are slashed as one block, like basalt split along hidden seams. Attacker cost: faking diverse human-like behavior per identity makes the Nth sybil costly instead of free. Limit: legitimate fleets also cluster, so an umber of doubt remains -- final slashing needs a human or DAO appeal.
